name: unity-polygon-streaming-vrm
description: Stream VRM 1.0 avatars with expressions, look-at, spring bones, VRMA, Mecanim humanoid, MToon shading, and first-person mesh filtering.
prerequisites: StreamController in the scene with Viewer Camera assigned
XRG derived from a VRM 1.0 source
UniVRM (com.vrmc.gltf + com.vrmc.vrm) required for VRMA and MToon
